d: Bible ke mutabik eesa masih ka khatna aathven din huaa tha, yahudi aur musalman aaj bhi khatna karte hain, to Christian dharm men ye zaruri kyon nahin? bharat men khatne ko sunnat ya musalmani kaha jata hai, lekin iski jar ibrahim aur usse bhi pahle Egypt ke Saqqara ki 4,300 sal purani kabr tak jati hai. Antiochus ka khatne par maut ka pharman, Paul ki dalil aur Jerusalem ki sabha ka phaisla, kuran men sidha hukm na hote hue bhi sunnat ki takat, Kellogg aur amerika ke aspatal, aur aaj HIV aur bachche ki marzi par bahsa. tinon dharmon ki bat puri izzat ke sath, sirph itihas ki nazar se.
